channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 08
item.description:
4 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • CCTV feeds now have a correct fade and color balance, matching BIRP, improving visibility when using surveillance cameras.

Animals & Farming

  • Unbred animals (wild or vendor‑bought) now have a capped breeding potential; only their offspring can be sold. The cap is configurable via livestock.potentialUnbredCap.

Gameplay & Balance

  • CCTV feeds now have a correct fade and color balance, matching BIRP, improving visibility when using surveillance cameras.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 07
item.description:
122 development commits

Animals & Livestock

  • A new 'potential' stat tracks an animal’s average happiness, influences vendor sale prices and prevents selling animals with zero potential; the value rises or falls over time based on current happiness.
  • Animals now dismount to the nearest valid spot with a physics check to avoid clipping through structures, and players receive toast notifications when mounting or dismounting fails due to obstacles.

Weapons & Combat

  • PT Boat turrets now support full viewmodels, reload functionality, corrected rear turret aiming, and smoother rendering to eliminate stutter.
  • Mortar fire is now synchronized for all players, ensuring consistent behavior.
  • Weapon shot settings have been corrected, improving firing reliability.
  • Grenade throw velocity has been increased, allowing grenades to travel farther.

Power & Generators

  • A biofuel generator pooling bug was fixed, restoring reliable fuel production.

Mounts & Horses

  • Horse animations and behavior were fixed: horses now sleep correctly, dismounted horses no longer keep their heads turned, and animation pooling issues are resolved.

Stability & Crash Fixes

  • A crash triggered by ore flare devices has been resolved, improving overall game stability.

Bug Fixes

  • Tool cupboards no longer appear on the map when the max tool cupboard limit is disabled at runtime.
  • Viewmodel skins are restored and work correctly again.
  • The wounded first‑person sound now plays in builds (volume reduced by 50%).
  • Gun jitter is eliminated when turning animations are playing.
  • Harbor bridge and crane sounds no longer play on initial load.
  • RC computer screen blur issue fixed.
  • Spectator viewmodel drop animations now play correctly.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Added a sound effect when selling wool or animals, providing audible confirmation of the transaction.
  • Fixed a crash that occurred when copying and pasting invulnerable entities, allowing seamless duplication.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 06
item.description:
115 development commits

World & Navigation

  • Map icons for Tool Cupboards added and deep‑sea marker issues fixed, improving map clarity and preventing marker loss.
  • Ferry terminal rope ladder climbing fixed, eliminating climb glitches and stuck rung animations.

Combat & AI

  • Hit detection improved and boars now flee only below 30 % health, making combat more reliable and boar encounters less premature.
  • Livestock movement and feeding behavior refined, preventing cows from clipping and improving eating at troughs and grass.

Crafting & Items

  • New tea mixing‑table recipes and Wool Armor introduced, expanding crafting options and providing Tier 1 protection.
  • Crafting action moved to D‑pad down on all controller layouts for easier access.

Audio & Sound

  • BBQ and flame turret sounds corrected and one‑shot spawn noises (furnaces, campfires, mixing tables) silenced for a cleaner audio experience.

Player Impact

  • Fixed horses being able to fly, preventing unintended movement exploits.
  • Boombox mission events now only trigger for teammates on the same mission, avoiding irrelevant alerts.
  • Resolved client crashes caused by late-arriving network snapshots, improving stability during map transitions.
  • Tattoos now correctly persist between client and server, ensuring player cosmetics are saved.
  • Reloading maps now correctly includes level size data, preventing loading confusion when switching between maps.
  • Fixed several character customization bugs: UI fading issue, unwanted underwear prompt, and teleporting back to start when opening the menu.
  • Bee grenade prediction no longer shows a white grenade model, fixing visual glitch during throw prediction.
  • Fixed a NaN vertex lighting issue that could crash the game.
  • Helicopter flares now save correctly without corrupting job handlers, restoring flare functionality after saving.
  • Made helicopter flare saving thread‑safe, preventing crashes when multiple flares are saved simultaneously.
